verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents scheduled data exports to cloud storage/email and APIs for customer/transaction data, and even an import path for migrating *into* RevenueCat, but there is no evidence of exporting invoices specifically or of porting stored payment methods out to another provider — RevenueCat generally doesn't hold payment methods itself (they live with Apple/Google/Stripe). Community discussion also flags migrating across store/Stripe providers as inherently hard, undermining a full portability claim. Missing for 10: documented invoice export, explicit payment-method export/migration tooling, and confirmation of smooth cross-provider migration.
